issues.failure_explanation: The proof turns (a*y)^*=a*y into Hermitian symmetry of R_a R_y. But R_{x^*}=R_x^H fails for general M, as the paper itself admits. diagnostic_evidence.quote: are isomorphic if their realness is the same

issues.failure_explanation: Realness m can be any value in {0..n} with m≡n mod 2, which gives floor(n/2)+1 classes, not ceil(n/2). For n=2, C (realness 0) and the split-complex numbers (realness 2) are two non-isomorphic tubal rings, against the formula's value of 1. The count also needs the unproved converse, that different realness gives non-isomorphic rings; prop:realness-iso proves only 'if'.

issues.title: Wrong count of tubal rings up to isomorphism; converse unproved
